What we create makes an impact.
Network

Present solutions to AT&T business customers to operate and manage large-scale text campaigns through 3rd party aggregators.

Consumer Solutions

Provide our customers a state-of-the-art mobile experience, allowing them to buy and operate their account with ease.

Center Of Excellence

Drive AT&T to become a more productive company by adopting advanced engineering principles, practices & tools, leveraging GenAI to boost the software delivery lifecycle, and maintaining cost-efficiency.

Security Products

Position AT&T as a leader in cybersecurity, with advanced capabilities and tailored solutions for various industries, leveraging our network capabilities and insights.

Field Operation

Orchestrate, translate and process all channels supporting field dispatch to meet nationwide customer commitments.

Business Solutions

Cater solutions for AT&T Business customers, allowing them to learn,
buy and manage through digital channels in a self-serve mode.

Technologies
How we bring ideas to life.
Focusing On Personal Growth

Every employee builds a unique personal growth plan, including a diverse array of opportunities such as specialized courses, skill development workshops, conferences, personal goals and more.

Driving Excellence Through Community

We enhance our skills with cross-team initiatives: enriching guild sessions, innovation-focused hackathons, tech fests, professional growth activities, and more – all while having fun.

Leading In The Ecosystem

We love sharing our expertise with the tech world - hosting meetups at AT&T’s ‘Stage 26,’ speaking at top conferences, and leading exclusive training sessions – our people are there.
